summary: Edgecombe County lookout on US 258 north of Fountain; a 2005 note said it was in disrepair, and the directory notes state-owned land and a March 2018 state surplus auction. No source says what stands today.

facts.agency: North Carolina Division of Forest Resources
facts.status_note: A 2005 recovery note said the tower appeared to be in disrepair. No source found says whether it still stands.

events.note: North Carolina Geodetic Survey described a survey mark at one leg of the tower, reached by driving 1.5 miles north on US 258 from its junction with NC 222.
Survey mark recovered in good condition.
Recovery note said the tower appeared to be in disrepair, while the concrete footing and steel plate were in good condition.
State surplus auction opened for bids; the directory entry says the tower was on state-owned land. The sources do not record an outcome.

notes_for_editor: No build date, height, builder or staffing found in any source. The 2018 surplus auction has no recorded outcome; check state surplus records before publishing anything about what is there now. Survey mark EY1216 is described as on the tower's footing, which places the tower about 1.5 miles north of the US 258 and NC 222 junction. Not listed on the National Historic Lookout Register.
